reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge in sports video understanding lies in resolving ambiguities arising from occlusion, motion, and interaction. The proposed SportMV-Agent framework addresses this by introducing an iterative loop of view selection, perception, and reasoning. This process is modeled as a sequential decision-making problem where each agent action A modifies the state S of available visual evidence, aiming to maximize reward R. The system leverages multi-view redundancy to improve perceptual accuracy beyond what any single view offers. In GSI, this translates into a Bayesian update mechanism over evidence sets E_i, where each new view contributes to posterior belief P(J|E_i). In GSE, it becomes a state transition graph where states represent partial visual understanding, and actions correspond to selecting new views. The failure mode occurs when the agent selects irrelevant views or misinterprets evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning outcomes.
